COT52vs156ShiftBearish.name: (COT07) 52v156 Shift Bearish
COT52vs156ShiftBearish.help_text: 52w vs 156w Positioning Shift (Bearish). Hedgers recently LESS bullish, speculators recently MORE bullish than structural baseline. (Strategy 3 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COT52vs156ShiftBullish.name: (COT06) 52v156 Shift Bullish
COT52vs156ShiftBullish.help_text: 52w vs 156w Positioning Shift (Bullish). Detects when recent (52w) positioning diverges bullishly from structural (156w). HedgerShift = H52-H156 > threshold AND SpecShift = S52-S156 < -threshold. Finds regime changes BEFORE absolute extremes develop. (Strategy 3) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTAccumulationBearish.name: (COT28) Accumulation Bearish
COTAccumulationBearish.help_text: Distribution (Bearish). H52 falling AND S52 rising for N consecutive weeks - institutional distribution. (Strategy 17+31 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTAccumulationBullish.name: (COT27) Accumulation Bullish
COTAccumulationBullish.help_text: Accumulation (Bullish). H52 rising AND S52 falling for N consecutive weeks - classic institutional accumulation pattern. Hedgers building longs while specs sell. (Strategy 17+31) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTBearishExtreme.name: COT Bearish Extreme
COTBearishExtreme.help_text: Hedger vs Speculator Extreme Reversal (Bearish). Hedgers at extreme low CPI AND speculators at extreme high CPI on the 52-week window. Mirror of Strategy 1. This rare divergence historically precedes major bearish reversals. (Strategy 2) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTBullishExtreme.name: COT Bullish Extreme
COTBullishExtreme.help_text: Hedger vs Speculator Extreme Reversal (Bullish). Commercials at extreme high CPI (>0.90) AND speculators at extreme low CPI (<0.10) on the 52-week window, with optional 156-week structural confirmation. This rare divergence historically precedes major bullish reversals. Use as a slow regime filter, not a precise entry timer. (Strategy 1) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCompositeScore.name: (COT) Composite Score
COTCompositeScore.help_text:
COT Composite Score. Combines BOTH lookback windows into a single regime indicator: avg(HedgerCPI_52w, HedgerCPI_156w) - avg(SpecCPI_52w, SpecCPI_156w). " +
	"Range: roughly -1 to +1. " +
	"Value > 0 (positive): Hedgers are net bullish across both timeframes while speculators are net bearish — BULLISH regime. " +
	"Value = 0: No positioning edge — neutral regime. " +
	"Value < 0 (negative): Speculators are net bullish across both timeframes while hedgers are net bearish — BEARISH regime. " +
	"This is the most comprehensive single COT metric as it averages both short-term (52w) and long-term (156w) positioning. " +
	"Typical usage: allow LONG trades when COTScore > +0.30, SHORT trades when COTScore < -0.30. " +
	"Zero crossovers can signal regime changes. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTConvergence.name: (COT38) H/S Convergence
COTConvergence.help_text: Hedger/Speculator Convergence filter. |H52 - S52| < threshold means hedgers and speculators agree. No clear COT edge - avoid directional trades or use mean-reversion. (Strategy 28) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCpihedg.name: (COT) Hedger CPI
COTCpihedg.help_text:
COT Hedger CPI (Commitment Percentile Index). Measures where commercial hedger net positioning ranks within its historical range over the selected lookback window (52w or 156w). " +
	"Range: 0 to 1. " +
	"Value = 0: Hedgers at their MOST NET-SHORT of the lookback — they expect prices to FALL — BEARISH signal. " +
	"Value = 0.5: Hedgers at the median of their historical range — neutral. " +
	"Value = 1: Hedgers at their MOST NET-LONG of the lookback — they expect prices to RISE — BULLISH signal. " +
	"Hedgers (commercials) are considered SMART MONEY — they produce/consume the commodity and hedge real business exposure. " +
	"Extreme readings (above 0.8 or below 0.2) are strong contrarian signals against speculator positioning. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCpismall.name: (COT) Small Trader CPI
COTCpismall.help_text:
COT Small Trader CPI (Non-Reportable Percentile Index). Measures where small trader (retail) net positioning ranks within its historical range. " +
	"Range: 0 to 1. " +
	"Value = 0: Small traders at their MOST NET-SHORT — retail is maximally bearish — contrarian BULLISH. " +
	"Value = 0.5: Small traders at median — neutral. " +
	"Value = 1: Small traders at their MOST NET-LONG — retail is maximally bullish — contrarian BEARISH. " +
	"Small traders are often called DUMB MONEY — they tend to be wrong at extremes. " +
	"Fading small traders (going opposite to their extreme positioning) is a classic contrarian strategy. " +
	"Best used in combination with Hedger CPI for confirmation. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCpispec.name: (COT) Speculator CPI
COTCpispec.help_text:
COT Speculator CPI (Commitment Percentile Index). Measures where large speculator net positioning ranks within its historical range over the selected lookback window (52w or 156w). " +
	"Range: 0 to 1. " +
	"Value = 0: Speculators at their MOST NET-SHORT — crowd is maximally bearish — contrarian BULLISH signal. " +
	"Value = 0.5: Speculators at the median — neutral. " +
	"Value = 1: Speculators at their MOST NET-LONG — crowd is maximally bullish — contrarian BEARISH signal. " +
	"Speculators (managed money, hedge funds) are trend-followers and often considered DUMB MONEY at extremes. " +
	"When speculators are at one extreme while hedgers are at the opposite extreme, it creates the strongest contrarian signals. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCrossFieldSpread.name: (COT) Cross-Field Spread
COTCrossFieldSpread.help_text:
COT Cross-Field Spread — the difference between any two COT fields. " +
	"Spread = Field1 - Field2, range -1 to +1. " +
	"Example: FieldIndex1=0 (cpihedg), FieldIndex2=3 (ctispec) for Pavel's Euro combination. " +
	"Useful for measuring divergences between different COT measures: " +
	"cpihedg vs cpispec (hedger-speculator gap), cpihedg vs ctihedg (CPI vs CTI divergence), etc. " +
	"Field indices: 0=cpihedg, 1=ctihedg, 2=cpispec, 3=ctispec, 4=cpismall. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCrowdingUnwind.name: COT Crowding Unwind
COTCrowdingUnwind.help_text: Crowding Unwind. Detects when a crowded positioning extreme is unwinding. The previously crowded group has moved past its normalize threshold and is still moving away from the extreme. (Strategy 8) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCtihedg.name: (COT) Hedger CTI
COTCtihedg.help_text:
COT Hedger CTI (Williams COT Index). Alternative normalization of commercial hedger positioning using the Williams formula: (current - lowest) / (highest - lowest). " +
	"Range: 0 to 1. " +
	"Value = 0: Hedgers at the bottom of their range — BEARISH (not buying). " +
	"Value = 1: Hedgers at the top of their range — BULLISH (smart money accumulating). " +
	"Similar to Hedger CPI but uses raw net position extremes instead of percentile ranking. " +
	"Both CPI and CTI measure the same concept — use whichever your analysis prefers. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTCtispec.name: (COT) Speculator CTI
COTCtispec.help_text:
COT Speculator CTI (Williams COT Index). Alternative normalization of large speculator positioning using the Williams formula: (current - lowest) / (highest - lowest). " +
	"Range: 0 to 1. " +
	"Value = 0: Speculators at the bottom of their range — crowd is bearish — contrarian BULLISH. " +
	"Value = 1: Speculators at the top of their range — crowd is bullish — contrarian BEARISH. " +
	"Similar to Speculator CPI but uses raw net position extremes instead of percentile ranking. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTExtremeExitBearish.name: (COT11) Extreme Exit Bearish
COTExtremeExitBearish.help_text: Extreme Exit (Bearish). Speculator was crowded long, now normalizing below exit threshold. (Strategy 6+24 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTExtremeExitBullish.name: (COT10) Extreme Exit Bullish
COTExtremeExitBullish.help_text: Extreme Exit (Bullish). Trades the normalization phase AFTER an extreme. Waits for hedger H52 to have been above ExtremeThreshold recently, then requires H52 to have fallen below ExitThreshold now. (Strategy 6+24) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTExtremePersistence.name: (COT12) Extreme Persistence
COTExtremePersistence.help_text: Extreme Persistence. Checks if an extreme has persisted for N consecutive weeks. Direction=1: bullish H52 persistence. Direction=-1: bearish S52 persistence. Young vs mature extremes give different signals. (Strategy 7+23) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTExtremeUnwindBearish.name: (COT14) Extreme Unwind Bearish
COTExtremeUnwindBearish.help_text: Extreme Unwind (Bearish). Hedger was extremely bullish, now retreating past normalize level. (Strategy 8 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTExtremeUnwindBullish.name: (COT13) Extreme Unwind Bullish
COTExtremeUnwindBullish.help_text: Extreme Unwind (Bullish). Spec was crowded long, now unwinding past normalize threshold and still falling. More conservative than ExtremeExit - requires both level AND direction confirmation. (Strategy 8) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTFieldValue.name: (COT) Field Value
COTFieldValue.help_text:
COT Field Value — generic accessor for any COT field by index. " +
	"Returns the raw normalized value (0 to 1) for the selected field. " +
	"FieldIndex: 0=Hedger CPI, 1=Hedger CTI, 2=Speculator CPI, 3=Speculator CTI, 4=Small Trader CPI. " +
	"Use multiple instances with different FieldIndex values to feed all 5 COT fields into a model. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTFullCycleExitLong.name: COT Full-Cycle Exit Long
COTFullCycleExitLong.help_text:
COT Full-Cycle Exit Long (Strategy 39). Exit the long position when hedger CPI reaches the ExitLevel. " +
	"Recommended exit thresholds to test: 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90. " +
	"Designed to ride the entire COT normalization cycle from extreme low to high. " +
	"Pair with COTFullCycleLong for the complete cycle strategy. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTFullCycleExitShort.name: COT Full-Cycle Exit Short
COTFullCycleExitShort.help_text:
COT Full-Cycle Exit Short (Strategy 39). Exit the short position when hedger CPI drops below the ExitLevel. " +
	"Recommended exit thresholds to test: 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40. " +
	"Designed to ride the entire COT normalization cycle from extreme high to low. " +
	"Pair with COTFullCycleLong for the complete cycle strategy. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTFullCycleLong.name: COT Full-Cycle Long Entry
COTFullCycleLong.help_text:
COT Full-Cycle Long Entry (Strategy 39). Enter long when hedger CPI crosses the EntryLevel upward: " +
	"previous bar COT < EntryLevel AND current bar COT >= EntryLevel. " +
	"Designed for position trading: hold for weeks/months until exit level reached. " +
	"Recommended entry thresholds to test: 0.10, 0.20, 0.30. " +
	"Pair with COTFullCycleExitLong for the complete cycle strategy. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTFullCycleShort.name: COT Full-Cycle Short Entry
COTFullCycleShort.help_text:
COT Full-Cycle Short Entry (Strategy 39). Enter short when hedger CPI crosses the EntryLevel downward: " +
	"previous bar COT > EntryLevel AND current bar COT <= EntryLevel. " +
	"Designed for position trading: hold for weeks/months until exit level reached. " +
	"Recommended entry thresholds to test: 0.70, 0.80, 0.90. " +
	"Pair with COTFullCycleExitShort for the complete cycle strategy. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTHedgerAccelBearish.name: (COT16) Hedger Accel Bearish
COTHedgerAccelBearish.help_text: Hedger Acceleration (Bearish). Hedger 52w decelerating while speculators accelerate bearishly. (Strategy 9 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTHedgerAccelBullish.name: (COT15) Hedger Accel Bullish
COTHedgerAccelBullish.help_text: Hedger Acceleration (Bullish). Hedger 52w accelerating away from 156w while speculators decelerate. Detects strengthening institutional conviction. (Strategy 9) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTHedgerSpecSpread.name: (COT) Hedger-Spec Spread
COTHedgerSpecSpread.help_text:
COT Hedger-Speculator Spread. The difference between Hedger CPI and Speculator CPI for a single lookback window. " +
	"Range: -1 to +1. " +
	"Value > 0 (positive): Hedgers more bullish than speculators — institutional BULLISH divergence — favor LONG trades. " +
	"Value = 0: Hedgers and speculators equally positioned — neutral. " +
	"Value < 0 (negative): Speculators more bullish than hedgers — speculative excess — favor SHORT trades. " +
	"Large positive values (above +0.4) indicate strong smart-money bullishness vs dumb-money bearishness. " +
	"Large negative values (below -0.4) indicate speculative euphoria that often precedes reversals. " +
	"This is the most direct measure of the institutional vs speculative positioning gap. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTHigherLow.name: (COT25) Higher Low (COT Div)
COTHigherLow.help_text: COT Higher Low (Institutional Divergence). COTScore is making a higher low compared to a recent trough. Pair with price making a lower low for a classic COT divergence setup. (Strategy 15+32) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTLowerHigh.name: (COT26) Lower High (COT Div)
COTLowerHigh.help_text: COT Lower High. COTScore making a lower high while price potentially makes a higher high - bearish COT divergence. (Strategy 15+32 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTMomentum.name: (COT) Momentum
COTMomentum.help_text:
COT Momentum — the change in a COT field over N bars. COTMomentum = CPI[now] - CPI[Lookback bars ago]. " +
	"Range: -1 to +1. Positive = positioning accelerating, negative = positioning decelerating. " +
	"FieldIndex: 0=cpihedg, 1=ctihedg, 2=cpispec, 3=ctispec, 4=cpismall. " +
	"Lookback: number of bars to measure change over (default 4 = ~1 month weekly). — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTMomentumRevBearish.name: (COT44) Momentum Rev Bearish
COTMomentumRevBearish.help_text: Momentum Reversal (Bearish). COTScore momentum crosses from positive to negative. (Strategy 30 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTMomentumRevBullish.name: (COT43) Momentum Rev Bullish
COTMomentumRevBullish.help_text: Momentum Reversal (Bullish). COTScore momentum crosses from negative to positive. The rate of change of institutional positioning flips from deteriorating to improving. (Strategy 30) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTMultiFieldCombo.name: (COT) Multi-Field Combo
COTMultiFieldCombo.help_text:
COT Multi-Field Combo — combines multiple COT fields into a single composite score. " +
	"Default: avg(cpihedg, 1-cpispec, 1-cpismall, 1-ctispec). " +
	"Pavel's Euro (6E) recommendation: use cpihedg + cpispec + cpismall + ctispec together. " +
	"Range: 0 to 1. Value > 0.5 = bullish composite, < 0.5 = bearish composite. " +
	"Hedger fields contribute positively (high hedger = bullish). " +
	"Speculator and small trader fields are inverted (high spec = bearish, so inverted). " +
	"Works with any COT symbol. Best tested on FX (especially Euro 6E), commodities, and metals. " +
	"Use EnableField parameters to include/exclude specific COT fields from the composite. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTMultiWindowBearish.name: (COT46) Multi-Window Bearish
COTMultiWindowBearish.help_text: Multi-Window Confirmation (Bearish). Both 52w and 156w windows confirm bearish regime. (Strategy 34 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTMultiWindowBullish.name: (COT45) Multi-Window Bullish
COTMultiWindowBullish.help_text: Multi-Window Confirmation (Bullish). Both 52w AND 156w windows must confirm bullish regime. More conservative than single-window - requires structural and tactical alignment. (Strategy 34) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTNeutralZone.name: (COT31) Neutral Zone
COTNeutralZone.help_text: Neutral Zone filter. |COTScore| < NeutralBand indicates no strong COT signal. Use to AVOID trading when positioning is ambiguous, or apply mean-reversion logic. (Strategy 20) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTRegimeShiftBearish.name: (COT40) Regime Shift Bearish
COTRegimeShiftBearish.help_text: Rapid Regime Shift (Bearish). COTScore was positive (bullish) recently but has dropped below negative Level. (Strategy 29 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTRegimeShiftBullish.name: (COT39) Regime Shift Bullish
COTRegimeShiftBullish.help_text: Rapid Regime Shift (Bullish). COTScore was negative (bearish) within N weeks but is now above Level. Detects fast turnarounds in institutional positioning. (Strategy 29) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTRocBearish.name: (COT37) ROC Bearish
COTRocBearish.help_text: Rate of Change (Bearish). Spread ROC below negative threshold - divergence widening bearishly. (Strategy 26 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTRocBullish.name: (COT36) ROC Bullish
COTRocBullish.help_text: Rate of Change (Bullish). H52-S52 spread ROC above threshold. Measures how rapidly the hedger-speculator divergence is widening in the bullish direction. (Strategy 26) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreAbove.name: COT Score Above
COTScoreAbove.help_text: COT Composite Score Above threshold (Bullish regime). COTScore = avg(hedger52, hedger156) - avg(spec52, spec156). Score > threshold indicates institutional bullish positioning. Use as a regime filter to allow long trades. (Strategy 5) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreAccelBearish.name: (COT48) Score Accel Bearish
COTScoreAccelBearish.help_text: Score Acceleration (Bearish). COTScore momentum accelerating downward - institutional conviction weakening. (Strategy 35 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreAccelBullish.name: (COT47) Score Accel Bullish
COTScoreAccelBullish.help_text: Score Acceleration (Bullish). COTScore momentum is accelerating upward (2nd derivative positive). Current momentum exceeds previous momentum. Institutional conviction is strengthening. (Strategy 35) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreBelow.name: COT Score Below
COTScoreBelow.help_text: COT Composite Score Below threshold (Bearish regime). Score < threshold indicates institutional bearish positioning. Use as a regime filter to allow short trades. (Strategy 5 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreMomentumAbove.name: (COT17) Score Momentum Above
COTScoreMomentumAbove.help_text: COTScore Momentum Above threshold. Measures rate of change of COTScore. Set LevelThreshold=0 for pure momentum (Str10), or LevelThreshold>0 for level+momentum (Str37). (Strategy 10+37) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreMomentumBelow.name: (COT18) Score Momentum Below
COTScoreMomentumBelow.help_text: COTScore Momentum Below negative threshold. Falling COT momentum indicates deteriorating institutional positioning. (Strategy 10+37 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreZeroCrossDown.name: (COT20) Score Zero Cross Down
COTScoreZeroCrossDown.help_text: COTScore Zero Cross Down. COTScore crosses below zero - regime transition from bullish to bearish. (Strategy 11 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTScoreZeroCrossUp.name: (COT19) Score Zero Cross Up
COTScoreZeroCrossUp.help_text: COTScore Zero Cross Up. COTScore crosses above zero - regime transition from bearish to bullish. A simple but effective regime change signal. (Strategy 11) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSeasonalBearish.name: (COT42) Seasonal Bearish
COTSeasonalBearish.help_text: Seasonal Filter (Bearish). Hedger CPI unusually below its seasonal average. (Strategy 27 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSeasonalBullish.name: (COT41) Seasonal Bullish
COTSeasonalBullish.help_text: Seasonal Filter (Bullish). Current hedger CPI is unusually above its seasonal average for this week-of-year. Filters out normal seasonal patterns to identify genuine positioning shifts. (Strategy 27) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSmallFadeBearish.name: (COT33) Small Fade Bearish
COTSmallFadeBearish.help_text: Small Trader Fade (Bearish). Small traders at extreme optimism = contrarian bearish. (Strategy 22 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSmallFadeBullish.name: (COT32) Small Fade Bullish
COTSmallFadeBullish.help_text: Small Trader Fade (Bullish). Small traders at extreme pessimism = contrarian bullish. Retail crowd is maximally bearish, historically a good time to be long. (Strategy 22) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSmartDumbBearish.name: (COT30) Smart vs Dumb Bearish
COTSmartDumbBearish.help_text: Smart vs Dumb Money (Bearish). Hedgers bearish, small traders bullish - fade the retail crowd. (Strategy 19 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSmartDumbBullish.name: (COT29) Smart vs Dumb Bullish
COTSmartDumbBullish.help_text: Smart vs Dumb Money (Bullish). Hedgers (smart money) bullish above threshold AND small traders (dumb money) bearish below threshold. Classic fade-the-public signal. (Strategy 19) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSpecExhaustionLong.name: (COT22) Spec Exhaustion Long
COTSpecExhaustionLong.help_text: Speculator Exhaustion (Long signal). Spec was crowded short, now rising with hedger at high levels confirming bullish. (Strategy 13 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSpecExhaustionShort.name: (COT21) Spec Exhaustion Short
COTSpecExhaustionShort.help_text: Speculator Exhaustion (Short signal). Spec was crowded long recently, now falling with hedger at opposing low levels. Fading exhausted speculative longs. (Strategy 13) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSpecTrendLong.name: (COT08) Spec Trend Long
COTSpecTrendLong.help_text: Speculator Trend Following (Long). Follows moderate speculator conviction (not yet extreme). S52 in [SpecMin,SpecMax] band, S156 > structural minimum, S52 rising. (Strategy 4+12) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSpecTrendShort.name: (COT09) Spec Trend Short
COTSpecTrendShort.help_text: Speculator Trend Following (Short). Follows moderate speculative bearish conviction without being at extremes. (Strategy 4+12 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSpreadZScoreBearish.name: (COT35) Spread ZScore Bearish
COTSpreadZScoreBearish.help_text: Spread Z-Score (Bearish). Z-score below negative threshold indicates statistically extreme bearish divergence. (Strategy 25 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTSpreadZScoreBullish.name: (COT34) Spread ZScore Bullish
COTSpreadZScoreBullish.help_text: Spread Z-Score (Bullish). H52-S52 spread Z-score above threshold. Measures how statistically extreme the current hedger-speculator divergence is relative to recent history. (Strategy 25) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTTripleDivBearish.name: (COT24) Triple Div Bearish
COTTripleDivBearish.help_text: Triple Positioning Divergence (Bearish). All 3 groups confirm bearish: hedgers low, specs high, small traders high. (Strategy 14 mirror) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTTripleDivBullish.name: (COT23) Triple Div Bullish
COTTripleDivBullish.help_text: Triple Positioning Divergence (Bullish). All 3 trader groups confirm: hedgers high, specs low, small traders low. Maximum conviction signal - rare but powerful. (Strategy 14) — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTVixProxyBearish.name: COT VIX Proxy Bearish
COTVixProxyBearish.help_text:
VIX COT Proxy Bearish — uses VIX futures COT instead of direct index COT for equity index trading. " +
	"BEARISH signal: VIX hedgers at extreme LOW (smart money complacent, not hedging) " +
	"AND VIX speculators at extreme HIGH (crowd positioned for vol = complacent about stocks). " +
	"Markets: Best for ES, NQ, YM, RTY. Uses VX (VIX futures) COT data. " +
	"Remember: VIX is inverse to stocks — low VIX hedger CPI = BEARISH for equities. " +
	"Pavel's research: direct stock index COT is less reliable; VIX COT may be more predictive. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTVixProxyBullish.name: COT VIX Proxy Bullish
COTVixProxyBullish.help_text:
VIX COT Proxy Bullish — uses VIX futures COT instead of direct index COT for equity index trading. " +
	"Pavel's research: direct stock index COT is less reliable because the positioning-price relationship changes over regimes. " +
	"VIX COT may be more predictive for equity indices. " +
	"BULLISH signal: VIX hedgers at extreme HIGH (smart money expects volatility to fall = stocks rise) " +
	"AND VIX speculators at extreme LOW (crowd not positioned for vol). " +
	"Markets: Best for ES, NQ, YM, RTY. Uses VX (VIX futures) COT data. " +
	"Remember: VIX is inverse to stocks — high VIX hedger CPI = BULLISH for equities. — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTEmergencyExitLong.name: COT Emergency Exit Long
COTEmergencyExitLong.help_text:
COT Emergency Exit Long — price-based safety exit for COT cycle strategies. " +
	"Exit when the weekly close drops below the low of the previous month. " +
	"This provides catastrophic risk protection for the slow COT Full-Cycle strategy. " +
	"Pavel's recommendation: Always have a price-based emergency exit when holding positions for weeks/months based on COT cycles. " +
	"The MonthLookback parameter controls how many bars to look back for the monthly low (default 20 = ~1 month of daily bars, or 4 weekly bars). — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

COTEmergencyExitShort.name: COT Emergency Exit Short
COTEmergencyExitShort.help_text:
COT Emergency Exit Short — price-based safety exit for COT cycle strategies. " +
	"Exit when the weekly close rises above the high of the previous month. " +
	"This provides catastrophic risk protection for the slow COT Full-Cycle strategy. " +
	"Pavel's recommendation: Always have a price-based emergency exit when holding positions for weeks/months based on COT cycles. " +
	"The MonthLookback parameter controls how many bars to look back for the monthly high (default 20 = ~1 month of daily bars, or 4 weekly bars). — COT data provided by SpreadCharts.com

VPBearAboveBull.name: (VP11) Bear POC Above Bull POC
VPBearAboveBull.help_text: The Bear POC (highest-volume price of down-candles) sits above the Bull POC (highest-volume price of up-candles). Structural bearish sentiment  --  sellers dominated the higher prices, suggesting downward conviction.

VPBottomHeavyPOC.name: (VP13) Bottom-Heavy POC (Accumulation)
VPBottomHeavyPOC.help_text: POC sits in the lower portion of the profile range. POCPctDown < ThresholdPct means the POC is close to the bottom. Accumulation/buying pressure  --  most volume occurred near the lows, suggesting institutional accumulation. Bullish context.

VPBullAboveBear.name: (VP10) Bull POC Above Bear POC
VPBullAboveBear.help_text: The Bull POC (highest-volume price of up-candles) sits above the Bear POC (highest-volume price of down-candles). Structural bullish sentiment  --  buyers were willing to pay higher prices than sellers, suggesting upward conviction.

VPExcessReversalLong.name: (VP27L) Excess Reversal Long (Tail)
VPExcessReversalLong.help_text: Strong rejection at the lower extreme: price trades below VAL (wick below) then closes back inside value with a long lower wick relative to body. This excess/tail indicates strong responsive buying. Long signal targeting PPOC then PVAH.

VPExcessReversalShort.name: (VP27S) Excess Reversal Short (Tail)
VPExcessReversalShort.help_text: Strong rejection at the upper extreme: price trades above VAH (wick above) then closes back inside value with a long upper wick relative to body. This excess/tail indicates strong responsive selling. Short signal targeting PPOC then PVAL.

VPFallingPOC.name: (VP22) Falling POC (Short Regime)
VPFallingPOC.help_text: POC migration downward: current session POC is lower than the prior session POC by at least MinimumShift pips. Lookback is auto-calculated from chart timeframe. Falling fair value suggests a bearish regime—prefer short setups on rallies to prior POC/value levels.

VPHighDelta.name: (VP08) High Delta (Bull Dominance)
VPHighDelta.help_text: Session delta (bull volume minus bear volume) exceeds a minimum threshold. Positive delta confirms aggressive buying  --  order flow supports bullish setups.

VPHighNegDelta.name: (VP09) High Negative Delta (Bear Dominance)
VPHighNegDelta.help_text: Session delta (bull volume minus bear volume) is below a negative threshold. Negative delta confirms aggressive selling  --  order flow supports bearish setups.

VPIBBreakoutDown.name: (VP19) IB Breakout Down
VPIBBreakoutDown.help_text: Price is below the Initial Balance Low (IBL). One of the most powerful intraday VP setups  --  price leaving the IB range downward signals directional conviction and often leads to a full-range extension to the downside.

VPIBBreakoutUp.name: (VP18) IB Breakout Up
VPIBBreakoutUp.help_text: Price is above the Initial Balance High (IBH). One of the most powerful intraday VP setups  --  price leaving the IB range upward signals directional conviction and often leads to a full-range extension to the upside.

VPIBRejectionLong.name: (VP44) IB Rejection Long
VPIBRejectionLong.help_text: Price tests the Initial Balance Low (IBL) -- low dips below or near IBL -- but closes back above it. Responsive buying defends the IB floor. Bullish reversal signal. Targets: POC then IBH.

VPIBRejectionShort.name: (VP45) IB Rejection Short
VPIBRejectionShort.help_text: Price tests the Initial Balance High (IBH) -- high pokes above or near IBH -- but closes back below it. Responsive selling defends the IB ceiling. Bearish reversal signal. Targets: POC then IBL.

VPLateAcceptanceFailureLong.name: (VP13L) Late Acceptance Failure Long
VPLateAcceptanceFailureLong.help_text: Market attempted acceptance below value (multiple closes below VAL) but later fails and returns into value. The extended acceptance below was a trap -- fade back toward POC then opposite VA edge (PVAH). Stronger than a simple value return because multiple bars confirmed the attempted breakout.

VPLateAcceptanceFailureShort.name: (VP13S) Late Acceptance Failure Short
VPLateAcceptanceFailureShort.help_text: Market attempted acceptance above value (multiple closes above VAH) but later fails and returns into value. The extended acceptance above was a trap -- fade back toward POC then opposite VA edge (PVAL). Stronger than a simple value return because multiple bars confirmed the attempted breakout.

VPNarrowValueArea.name: (VP15) Narrow Value Area
VPNarrowValueArea.help_text: The Value Area (VAH - VAL) is narrower than a maximum threshold in points. Narrow VA = compressed/trending day with tight acceptance  --  expect breakout and favor directional continuation strategies.

VPOpenDriveLong.name: (VPODL) Open Drive Long
VPOpenDriveLong.help_text: Market opens and drives aggressively upward without looking back. All of the first DriveBars consecutive bars after session open close higher than their opens (bullish candles) and the cumulative move exceeds MinimumMove pips. This is a high-conviction Open Drive -- one of the strongest trend day signals. Do not fade; trade with the direction.

VPOpenDriveShort.name: (VPODS) Open Drive Short
VPOpenDriveShort.help_text: Market opens and drives aggressively downward without looking back. All of the first DriveBars consecutive bars after session open close lower than their opens (bearish candles) and the cumulative move exceeds MinimumMove pips. This is a high-conviction Open Drive -- one of the strongest trend day signals. Do not fade; trade with the direction.

VPPOCAtEdgeLong.name: (VPEL) POC At Edge Long (Imbalanced Up)
VPPOCAtEdgeLong.help_text: POC sits near the top of the value area (within EdgePct% of the VA range from VAH). When the most-traded price is at the top of value, the market is imbalanced upward -- the auction is 'one-sided' and likely to continue higher. Long regime filter.

VPPOCAtEdgeShort.name: (VPES) POC At Edge Short (Imbalanced Down)
VPPOCAtEdgeShort.help_text: POC sits near the bottom of the value area (within EdgePct% of the VA range from VAL). When the most-traded price is at the bottom of value, the market is imbalanced downward -- the auction is 'one-sided' and likely to continue lower. Short regime filter.

VPPOCMagnetLong.name: (VP11L) POC Magnet Mean Reversion (Long)
VPPOCMagnetLong.help_text: Inside-value mean reversion: price is inside the prior value area but stretched below POC by at least MinimumDeviation pips. The POC acts as a magnet pulling price back toward fair value. Long bias targeting a return to PPOC.

VPPOCMagnetShort.name: (VP11S) POC Magnet Mean Reversion (Short)
VPPOCMagnetShort.help_text: Inside-value mean reversion: price is inside the prior value area but stretched above POC by at least MinimumDeviation pips. The POC acts as a magnet pulling price back toward fair value. Short bias targeting a return to PPOC.

VPPriceAbovePOC.name: (VP01) Price Above POC
VPPriceAbovePOC.help_text: Price is above the session's Point of Control (POC). Bullish directional bias  --  price trading above fair value suggests buyers are in control.

VPPriceBelowPOC.name: (VP02) Price Below POC
VPPriceBelowPOC.help_text: Price is below the session's Point of Control (POC). Bearish directional bias  --  price trading below fair value suggests sellers are in control.

VPPriceInsideVA.name: (VP03) Price Inside Value Area
VPPriceInsideVA.help_text: Price is inside the Value Area (between VAL and VAH). Indicates balanced/rotational market  --  favor mean reversion setups and range-bound strategies.

VPPriceOutsideVA.name: (VP04) Price Outside Value Area
VPPriceOutsideVA.help_text: Price is outside the Value Area (above VAH or below VAL). Indicates trending/breakout conditions  --  favor momentum and continuation setups.

VPRisingPOC.name: (VP21) Rising POC (Long Regime)
VPRisingPOC.help_text: POC migration upward: current session POC is higher than the prior session POC by at least MinimumShift pips. Lookback is auto-calculated from chart timeframe. Rising fair value suggests a bullish regime—prefer long setups on pullbacks to prior POC/value levels.

VPTopHeavyPOC.name: (VP12) Top-Heavy POC (Distribution)
VPTopHeavyPOC.help_text: POC sits in the upper portion of the profile range. POCPctUp < ThresholdPct means the POC is close to the top. Distribution/selling pressure  --  most volume occurred near the highs, suggesting institutional distribution. Bearish context.

VPVAHTestRejection.name: (VP09) VAH Test Rejection (Short)
VPVAHTestRejection.help_text: Price probes above prior VAH (high exceeds PVAH) but closes back below PVAH -- responsive sellers defend the value edge. Classic short setup: enter short near VAH after rejection. Targets: PPOC then PVAL.

VPVALTestRejection.name: (VP10) VAL Test Rejection (Long)
VPVALTestRejection.help_text: Price probes below prior VAL (low dips below PVAL) but closes back above PVAL -- responsive buyers defend the value edge. Classic long setup: enter long near VAL after rejection. Targets: PPOC then PVAH.

VPVWAPCrossDown.name: (VP28) VWAP Cross Down
VPVWAPCrossDown.help_text: Price crosses below the Anchored VWAP — current close is below VWAP while previous close was at or above. Momentum shift signal, often used for intraday reversal entries when price loses the volume-weighted mean.

VPVWAPCrossUp.name: (VP27) VWAP Cross Up
VPVWAPCrossUp.help_text: Price crosses above the Anchored VWAP — current close is above VWAP while previous close was at or below. Momentum shift signal, often used for intraday reversal entries when price reclaims the volume-weighted mean.

VPValueReturnLong.name: (VP12L) Value Return Long (80% Rule)
VPValueReturnLong.help_text: After leaving value below VAL, price re-enters the value area -- the breakout failed. Based on the classic 80% Rule: once price returns into value, it tends to rotate through to the opposite edge. Long signal targeting PPOC then PVAH.

VPValueReturnShort.name: (VP12S) Value Return Short (80% Rule)
VPValueReturnShort.help_text: After leaving value above VAH, price re-enters the value area -- the breakout failed. Based on the classic 80% Rule: once price returns into value, it tends to rotate through to the opposite edge. Short signal targeting PPOC then PVAL.

VPValueShiftDown.name: (VP24) Value Shift Down (Bear Regime)
VPValueShiftDown.help_text: Strong bearish regime: current session's VAH sits entirely below the prior session's VAL. The entire value area has shifted lower, indicating aggressive acceptance of lower prices. Prefer short setups—sell rallies into the new value area.

VPValueShiftUp.name: (VP23) Value Shift Up (Bull Regime)
VPValueShiftUp.help_text: Strong bullish regime: current session's VAL sits entirely above the prior session's VAH. The entire value area has shifted higher, indicating aggressive acceptance of higher prices. Prefer long setups—buy pullbacks into the new value area.

VPWideValueArea.name: (VP14) Wide Value Area
VPWideValueArea.help_text: The Value Area (VAH - VAL) is wider than a minimum threshold in points. Wide VA = balanced rotational day with broad acceptance  --  favor range-bound mean-reversion strategies.

NoTradeRecentlyClosed.help_text: Returns true if there wasn't active trade that was closed recently - which means at the same bar or even the same minute. This block can be used to filter too frequent trading and improve backtesting accuracy.

OpenPLInMoney.name: Open P/L (in money)
OpenPLInMoney.help_text: Returns open P/L for specified order in money. If you'll not specify any order, it will return sum of open P/L for all active orders.

OpenPLInPips.name: Open P/L (in pips)
OpenPLInPips.help_text: Returns open P/L for specified order in pips. If you'll not specify any order, it will return sum of open P/L for all active orders.

OrderOpenPrice.name: Order Open Price
OrderOpenPrice.help_text: Returns open price level for specified order

OrderPT.name: Order Profit Target
OrderPT.help_text: Returns Profit Target level for specified order

OrderSL.name: Order Stop Loss
OrderSL.help_text: Returns Stop Loss level for specified order

PendingOrderDoesntExist.name: Pending order doesn't exist
PendingOrderDoesntExist.help_text: Is triggered when there doesn't exist specified pending order

PendingOrderExists.name: PendingOrderExists
PendingOrderExists.help_text: Is triggered when there exists specified pending order

TradeRecentlyClosed.name: TradeRecentlyClosed
TradeRecentlyClosed.help_text: Returns true if there was active trade that was closed recently - which means at the same bar or even the same minute.

ExitAfterBars.name: ExitAfterBars
ExitAfterBars.help_text: Number of bars after which this trade will automatically be closed

ATRRiskBasedSizing.name: ATRRiskBasedSizing
ATRRiskBasedSizing.help_text:
ATR Risk-Based Position Sizing
Adjusts trade size so each trade risks a fixed % of equity based on ATR volatility.

CryptoFixedAmount.name: CryptoFixedAmount
CryptoFixedAmount.help_text: Strategy will risk given amount of money for every trade

CryptoSizeByPrice.name: CryptoSizeByPrice
CryptoSizeByPrice.help_text: Size computed as Balance / Asset Size. Position sizing method specifically for crypto trading - you have to specify the exact decimal numbers for rounding.

FixedAmount.name: FixedAmount
FixedAmount.help_text:
Strategy will risk given amount of money for every trade
This is basic money management without compounding. It can be used to test real performance of strategies whose Stop Loss is based on ATR.

FixedSize.name: FixedSize
FixedSize.help_text:
No money management
Strategy will trade with fixed number of lots.

PickerFixedAmount.name: PickerFixedAmount
PickerFixedAmount.help_text: Fixed - the method allocates fixed amount of capital and split into maximum positions allowed.

PickerRiskFixedPctOfAccount.name: PickerRiskFixedPctOfAccount
PickerRiskFixedPctOfAccount.help_text:
Risk % - the method allocates defined percent amount of the account capital to a selected strategy.
The amount will be split into maximum positions allowed.

RiskFixedPctOfAccount.name: RiskFixedPctOfAccount
RiskFixedPctOfAccount.help_text:
Risk fixed percentage of account size
Strategy will risk a given % of equity for every trade.

This is a simple but very effective money management that will allow the strategy to increase the number of lots as your account grows.

It is recommended to risk around 2-5% of the account per trade.

SimpleMartingaleMM.name: SimpleMartingaleMM
SimpleMartingaleMM.help_text:
Simple Martingale MM
Experimental feature
Characteristics:
  • Optional separate logic for Buy and Sell
  • Multiplies the last trade size by multiplier after loss
  • Resets size to a starting size after profit
  • When computed size is bigger than reset value, it uses Starting lots again

StocksSizeByPrice.name: StocksSizeByPrice
StocksSizeByPrice.help_text: Size computed as Balance / StockSize. Position sizing method specifically for stocks.

MACHRBlockRandomization.name: MACHRBlockRandomization
MACHRBlockRandomization.help_text: Randomizes blocks of trades using bootstrap sampling to simulate robustness against market regime changes. Divides trades into blocks and then samples blocks with replacement, preserving the internal structure within each block.

RandomizeTradesOrder.name: RandomizeTradesOrder
RandomizeTradesOrder.help_text: Randomizes order of trades using one of the methods. Please note that Resampling method is much more memory intensive than Exact method.

RandomlyDegradeExecution.name: RandomlyDegradeExecution
RandomlyDegradeExecution.help_text: Simulates execution issues like slippage or wider spreads by randomly worsening the Close Price for a subset of trades, based on a percentage of the trade's price range (Open to original Close).

SimulateParameterJitter.name: SimulateParameterJitter
SimulateParameterJitter.help_text: Simulates effects of minor strategy parameter instability by randomly skipping some trades and/or randomly adjusting the Close Price (better or worse) of others based on trade range.

RandomizeHistoryData.name: RandomizeHistoryData
RandomizeHistoryData.help_text: Note!This option is supposed to work best with Selected Timeframe precision.

RandomizeHistoryDataFixedRange.name: RandomizeHistoryDataFixedRange
RandomizeHistoryDataFixedRange.help_text: Note!This option is supposed to work best with Selected Timeframe precision.

RandomizeHistoryDataOHLC.name: RandomizeHistoryDataOHLC
RandomizeHistoryDataOHLC.help_text: Note!This option is supposed to work best with Selected Timeframe precision.

RandomizeStrategyParameters.name: RandomizeStrategyParameters
RandomizeStrategyParameters.help_text: If true, it uses symmetric parameters - the parameters will be shared for long and short side. Otherwise, the parameters for long and short side will be independent.

PerTrade.name: PerTrade
PerTrade.help_text:
Per trade commission
Applies commission to every trade entry and exit.

PercentageBased.name: PercentageBased
PercentageBased.help_text:
Percentage based commissions
Used mainly for stocks, it computes commission as % of actual price of purchased asset.

SizeBased.name: SizeBased
SizeBased.help_text:
Simple size-based commissions
Simple method of commissions computation - it uses commissions in $ per lot and multiplies it by actual trade size.

parameters.name: Commission type
parameters.editor_values: $ per share=share,$ per order=order,% of trade value=equity

DontTradeOnWeekends.name: DontTradeOnWeekends
DontTradeOnWeekends.help_text: Strategy won't perform any operations during weekends

ExitAtEndOfDay.name: ExitAtEndOfDay
ExitAtEndOfDay.help_text: Close all positions at end of day?

ExitOnFriday.name: ExitOnFriday
ExitOnFriday.help_text: Close all positions at end of the week (Friday)?

LimitTimeRange.name: LimitTimeRange
LimitTimeRange.help_text: Limit trading to given time range?

MaxDistanceFromMarket.name: MaxDistanceFromMarket
MaxDistanceFromMarket.help_text: Limits pending orders maximal distance from current market price

MaxTradesPerDay.name: MaxTradesPerDay
MaxTradesPerDay.help_text: Maximum allowed number of trades per day, 0 means there is no limit.

MinMaxSLPT.name: MinMaxSLPT
MinMaxSLPT.help_text: Minimum SL in pips, it will cut the SL value so that it is not smaller than this setting. If 0, no limit is used.

UseInitialSLPT.name: UseInitialSLPT
UseInitialSLPT.help_text: Sets StopLoss and ProfitTarget immediately after the order gets filled. Otherwise SL/PT is set on next bar

ExcludePctTradesWithBiggestPl.name: ExcludePctTradesWithBiggestPl
ExcludePctTradesWithBiggestPl.help_text: Exclude % of trades with biggest profit

ExcludePctTradesWithLowestPl.name: ExcludePctTradesWithLowestPl
ExcludePctTradesWithLowestPl.help_text: Exclude % of trades with biggest loss
